name: rigor
description: Run a universal, balanced, multi-pass evaluation that preserves every applicable user requirement, identifies what is good and bad, searches for missing considerations and downstream effects, verifies evidence, and produces an honest final judgment.

interface.longDescription: Evaluate requests, ideas, decisions, plans, designs, code, research, calculations, and other work from both the strongest case for and the strongest case against, then produce an evidence-backed conclusion.
defaultPrompt: Use $rigor to fully evaluate this from every relevant angle, including what is good, what is bad, and the most defensible conclusion.
